about: Tips the Welcome window shows, one per opening, in turn (HS-10). 'action' is the ActionCatalog id whose menu path the text names; TipsCheck holds the text to that path.

tips.text: Help > Search Controls... finds any command or control by name: Cmd-K on a Mac, Ctrl-K elsewhere.
Drop FITS or JPEG 2000 files anywhere on the window to load them as image layers; drop a .jhv file to open that session.
File > Set Current Session as Default opens this scene at every start, ahead of the last session.
View > Present shows the output only, full screen. Esc leaves.
File > Copy Provenance puts the program, its build and each layer's data source on the clipboard.
Edit > Undo takes back the last change to the scene.
Help > Take the Tour steps through the main controls, one at a time.
RHEF, in a layer's Filter list, is a visualization, not a calibrated radiance.
